page_desc: Tell another system when something happens here. The platform sends a signed message to the address you give.
community_help: Webhooks belong to one community. Choose whose webhooks to manage.
failed_to_load_communities: Could not load the list of communities
no_webhooks_desc: Add a webhook to send a message to another system when a shift is completed or a job application changes.
webhook_name_help: A name you will recognise, such as the system that receives the messages.
events_help: Only events the platform really sends are listed.

shift_completed.label: A volunteer completes a shift
shift_completed.desc: Sent when a volunteer checks out of a shift with a QR code.

job_vacancy_created.label: A job vacancy is posted
job_vacancy_created.desc: Sent when a new job vacancy is created.

job_application_created.label: Someone applies for a job
job_application_created.desc: Sent when a member sends in a job application.

job_application_status_changed.label: A job application's status changes
job_application_status_changed.desc: Sent when one application is moved to a new status.

job_application_bulk_status_changed.label: Several job applications change status at once
job_application_bulk_status_changed.desc: Sent when applications are moved in bulk.

job_offer_accepted.label: A job offer is accepted
job_offer_accepted.desc: Sent when a member accepts a job offer.

secret_desc: Copy it now and paste it into the receiving system. It is shown only this once. You can generate a new one later.
generate_secret_confirm: The receiving system will need the new secret before it can check any further message. The old secret stops working at once.
test_sent: The receiving system accepted the test message
test_failed: The receiving system did not accept the test message
filter_deliveries: Filter by event or response code…
no_deliveries: No deliveries yet for this webhook.
delete_webhook_confirm: Delete this webhook? The receiving system will stop getting messages.
failed_to_rotate_secret: Could not generate a new secret
